entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Order number is 994-128B-774.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 31 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band?
It's just not working. I've tried everything. It won't sync with the app at all, and the heart rate monitor is giving crazy numbers. The thing is basically broken.
I'm very sorry to hear that. A defective device is definitely not the experience we want for our customers.
Look, is it returnable or not? I don't have time for a long call.
Yes, of course. Let me just confirm the policy for you... Okay, I see here that you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you right now.

Consider it done. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with the pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method. Can I help with anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
